summary: Iteration 58 (AMS roll-up follow-ups #1-#3) tested end-to-end. Backend: 5 new pytest tests PASS (combined_data[].ams_shared_revenue + sums + non-AMS zero + persistence). Frontend: verified live in Playwright on freshly-created TEST projects — (a) Estimator toolbar buttons 'download-template-button', 'download-data-button', 'upload-grid-input' are absent; (b) Milestones page shows ams-recurring-card-{wave} for AMS_Shared waves with correct $7,000/mo and $42,000/yr totals across two buckets, and is NOT rendered for Implementation projects; (c) Cashflow page shows 6 purple 'AMS' badges per-wave and 6 in Combined Summary with 'incl. $7,000 AMS' sub-line, and zero badges for non-AMS project. Excel export/import code paths reviewed only (not executed in browser).

issues: Pre-existing hydration warnings on <span data-ve-dynamic> wrapping <tr> rows — carry-over from iter_55/56/57, not introduced this iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: financials.py L189,196,205,212: combined_data[].ams_shared_revenue is correctly summed from wave_monthly[].ams_shared_revenue per month; summary.total_ams_shared sums per-wave totals. Sum invariant verified by test_combined_data_ams_sums_to_summary.
Implementation projects correctly emit ams_shared_revenue=0 in every combined_data row (default branch). No KeyError risk in frontend.

PaymentMilestones.js L548: ams-recurring-card only renders for waves with engagement_type starting with 'AMS_' AND ams_shared_buckets.length > 0 — confirmed via Implementation project showing 0 cards.

CashflowStatement.js L407 / L478: ams-badge-wave-{idx} and ams-badge-combined-{idx} render only when row.ams_shared_revenue > 0 — visual confirmation shows purple badge + 'incl. $X AMS' sub-line on revenue cell; Impl project shows zero badges.

WaveContent.js: three handlers (handleDownloadWaveTemplate, handleDownloadWaveData, handleUploadWaveGrid) and their props/buttons are fully removed; the data-testids 'download-template-button', 'download-data-button', 'upload-grid-input' are not present anywhere in /app/frontend/src (grep confirmed).

excelExport.js L262-290 + L416-432: Per-wave AMS section ('AMS SHARED SUPPORT (...— N months contract)') and Summary 'AMS SHARED SUPPORT ROLL-UP' + 'GRAND TOTAL (Impl + AMS Y1)' rows added. existing 'GRAND TOTAL (Final Price)' row preserved at L407. NOTE: only reviewed statically — Excel buffer not parsed in this run.

excelImport.js L249-284: Header regex 'AMS SHARED SUPPORT \((\w+)\s*[—-]\s*(\d+)\s*months' captures engagement subtype ('Shared'/'Mix') and contract length; buckets pushed with name/hours/rate/notes; engagementType defaults back to 'Implementation' if no buckets — sensible. NOTE: parser distinguishes Mix only by substring 'mix' — 'Dedicated' would map to AMS_Shared today; this matches the spec which lists only AMS_Shared OR AMS_Mix as acceptable import targets.

Excel round-trip (export → import) was NOT exercised end-to-end in this run (would require a browser download + exceljs parse). Recommend a self-test by main agent or follow-up iteration with a Node script invoking the same util functions.
